folders.name: Folder Name
folders.title: Folders ({{count}})
folders.delete_warning: Deleting a folder will also delete all feeds and articles within it

settings.title: Settings
settings.auto_readability_description: Automatically switch to reader mode when viewing articles
settings.mark_read_on_scroll_description: Mark entries as read after they scroll past the top of the list
settings.proxy_enabled_description: Access feeds through a proxy server
settings.advanced_domain_limits_description: Set request intervals for specific domains
settings.appearance_categories_description: Drag to reorder or hide categories in the sidebar switcher
settings.appearance_keep_one: Keep at least one category view
settings.rsshub_description: Point at your own RSSHub (optionally with ACCESS_KEY). New RSSHub subscriptions use it automatically, and existing ones can be migrated in one click.
settings.scroll_read_keep_visible_description: Entries you scrolled past stay where they are (marked read, not removed yet) so the list does not jump; they disappear once you switch away or open another feed
settings.scroll_read_keep_visible_disabled: "Mark read on scroll" is off, so this has no effect
settings.scroll_read_per_view_hint: Per-view switches live in Appearance → Per-view settings
settings.rsshub_merge_description: These subscriptions would end up with the same URL as an existing one. Confirming merges them into a single source: the existing subscription is kept, entries/starred/folder are carried over, and the duplicate is removed.
settings.rsshub_merge_line: {{source}} ({{sourceEntries}} entries / {{sourceStarred}} starred) → merge into {{target}} ({{targetEntries}} entries / {{targetStarred}} starred)
settings.rsshub_merge_also: Another {{count}} subscription(s) only change URL and are unaffected.
settings.notify_description: Used by the automation action "Push to phone" when a rule leaves its URL empty. Bark-compatible: https://api.day.app/<your-key> (or your own Bark server).
settings.notify_hint: The URL contains your device key and stays in your own database. Matches push title + source, and tapping opens the entry.
settings.fetch_description: Scheduled refresh frequency and concurrency. Changes take effect from the next round — no restart needed.
settings.fetch_per_host_hint: Requests to the same host at once, default 6
settings.auto_refresh_history_hint: Scheduled refreshes no longer pop a dialog — they are logged here (the last 20, fixed). Expand a row for per-feed details; failures are listed first, grouped by reason. Manual refreshes still pop the dialog and are not logged here.
settings.auto_refresh_history_all_ok_hint: No feed failed in this run
settings.auto_refresh_history_clear_description: This deletes all {{count}} records and cannot be undone.
settings.unsaved_body: "{{pages}}" has unsaved changes. Leaving will discard them.

theme.label: Theme
theme.description: Pick the display mode; the two palettes below are chosen by this
theme.palette_description: One palette each for light and dark (from Nextflux); with “System” the app follows your OS

add_feed.title: Add Feed
add_feed.feed_description: Enter the URL of an RSS feed or website to subscribe
add_feed.feed_exists: This feed URL is already subscribed
add_feed.view_preview_no_image: No images in the first few entries — this feed may be empty in the pictures view

entry.expand_hint: Open in the reader for the full article
entry.original_site_hint: The original site is embedded below. If it stays blank, the site refuses framing — use Open in new tab.
entry.translate_fallback_hint: Some blocks failed on the free channel and were translated by the model instead
entry.force_confirm_description: This ignores etag / last-modified and refetches every feed in scope in one go (host cooldown is skipped too). That's a lot of feeds — confirm this wasn't a mis-selection.

ai_settings.translate_channel_hint: Summaries still use the provider above. Free no-key channels fall back to the model on failure.
ai_settings.request_options_hint: JSON object merged into the current request body
ai_settings.request_options_invalid: Request options must be a valid JSON object
ai_settings.rate_limit_hint: Maximum API requests per second. Range 1-100, default 10
ai_settings.summary_language_hint: The language used for AI-generated summaries and translations
ai_settings.auto_translate_hint: Automatically translate articles that are not in your target language
ai_settings.auto_summary_hint: Automatically generate AI summary when viewing articles
ai_settings.loopback_hint: Local address: inside Docker, 127.0.0.1 refers to the container itself — the backend switches to host.docker.internal automatically (no effect outside containers)
ai_settings.fallback_to_model: Fall back to the model on free-channel failure
ai_settings.fallback_to_model_hint: When on, failed blocks are retried with the provider above; when off they just error.
ai_settings.model_hint: Use the provider's model ID, or probe the list on the right.
ai_settings.mcp_servers_hint: Turn what an MCP server returns (a tool or a resource) into a feed; the same connection can also serve as an AI tool.
ai_settings.mcp_paste_json_label: Paste JSON (optional; auto-detected into the form above)
ai_settings.mcp_empty: No MCP connections yet. Use “New connection” to paste a config over, or fill it in manually.
ai_settings.mcp_delete_confirm_body: Deletes "{{name}}". If feeds still use it the server will refuse and tell you how many.
ai_settings.mcp_transport_hint: Auto-detect by default: try HTTP first, retry once over SSE on failure, and remember the last working transport.
ai_settings.mcp_header_mask_hint: Existing values show as {{mask}}: leave them untouched to keep the stored value (the server treats the mask as "unchanged").
ai_settings.mcp_purposes_hint: Both purposes can coexist on one connection; only connections marked "Feed" show up in the feed wizard.
ai_settings.mcp_fetch_hint: Configuring separately bypasses the global settings — recommended for rate-limited MCP servers.
ai_settings.mcp_refresh_interval_hint: Defaults: {{timeout}}s timeout / {{concurrency}} concurrent / every {{interval}} minutes; minimum interval {{min}} minutes.
ai_settings.mcp_err_url_invalid: The URL must start with http:// or https://
ai_settings.mcp_err_headers_incomplete: Both the header name and value are required
ai_settings.mcp_err_interval_too_small: The refresh interval cannot be less than {{min}} minutes
ai_settings.mcp_step_server_hint: Only enabled connections whose purpose includes "Used for feeds" are listed; “New connection” is the last item.
ai_settings.mcp_no_servers_for_feed: No connection can be used as a feed yet. Create one above and mark it "Used for feeds".
ai_settings.mcp_resource_hint: Resources carry their own uri and mimeType, so almost no mapping is needed.
ai_settings.mcp_arguments_invalid: Arguments must be a valid JSON object
ai_settings.mcp_limit_hint: One page per fetch by default; turn on “Backfill history” below to chase more.
ai_settings.mcp_page_history_hint: Follow cursors within a single call, capped by pages and items; first-time setup still fetches one page only.
ai_settings.mcp_load_more_hint: There is a next page — hit “Load more” to preview it
ai_settings.mcp_prompts_note: Prompts are not listed (useless for a reader)
ai_settings.mcp_mapping_hint: Prefilled from the response; re-preview after editing.
ai_settings.mcp_mapping_key_hint: You do not choose the dedup key: it degrades from "key field → link → title + time" automatically, and the preview shows which level was used.
ai_settings.mcp_tier_text: Plain text (may need a human hint)
ai_settings.mcp_text_tier_hint: The response is plain text and cannot be split automatically — point at field paths manually, or let AI guess a mapping.
ai_settings.mcp_ai_suggested: AI ({{model}}) guessed a mapping costing ~{{tokens}} tokens — hit “Use this mapping” to fill it in; it only takes effect after you confirm the preview
ai_settings.mcp_preview_hint: One glance tells you whether the mapping is right — creating stays blocked until a preview succeeds.
ai_settings.mcp_preview_required: No successful preview yet: click "Preview first 5" above. Re-preview after changing the mapping or arguments.
ai_settings.mcp_feed_hint: Once created it is an ordinary feed: it can live in a folder, be targeted by rules and filtered by views.
ai_settings.mcp_paste_hint: Three shapes: ① Claude / Cursor {"mcpServers":{…}} (several at once) ② a single {type,url,headers} ③ just a url (probed as “try HTTP, then SSE”).
ai_settings.mcp_parse_not_object: Top-level JSON must be an object
ai_settings.mcp_parse_no_servers: No creatable connection found (need an http(s) address)
ai_settings.mcp_parse_no_servers_found: No creatable connection found (need an http(s) address)
ai_settings.mcp_parse_stdio_unsupported: This is a desktop local-process config and is not supported on the web; fill in a remote HTTP / SSE address if the service has one
ai_settings.mcp_parse_url_invalid: Address must be a full URL starting with http(s)://
ai_settings.mcp_recognized_multi: Recognized {{count}} entries; each becomes a connection on save
ai_settings.mcp_oauth_discovery_note: The authorization server is discovered per the MCP spec
ai_settings.mcp_oauth_steps: ① read /.well-known/oauth-protected-resource → ② read /.well-known/oauth-authorization-server → ③ register the client (DCR; no manual work when a client_id comes back) → ④ authorize in the browser (PKCE) → ⑤ exchange the callback for tokens
ai_settings.mcp_oauth_callback: Callback: {{url}} (built from the address you are visiting; works remotely)
ai_settings.mcp_oauth_token_note: Tokens are stored masked and never logged
ai_settings.mcp_oauth_no_dcr: This service does not support auto-registration
ai_settings.mcp_oauth_save_first: Save the connection first, then come back to authorize
ai_settings.mcp_oauth_discovery_failed: Failed to discover the authorization server

data_control.confirm_delete: Confirm deleting all data? This action cannot be undone.
data_control.import_description: Import feeds and folders from OPML file
data_control.skipped_items: Skipped {{foldersSkipped}} existing folders and {{feedsSkipped}} existing feeds
data_control.export_description: Export all feeds and folders as OPML file
data_control.clear_ai_cache_description: Delete all AI-generated summaries and translations cache
data_control.clear_anubis_cookies_description: Delete all website access credentials (for bypassing protection)
data_control.clear_icon_cache_description: Delete all feed icon files (will re-fetch on next refresh)
data_control.clear_entry_cache_description: Delete all unstarred articles (starred articles are preserved)
data_control.export_settings_description: Export UI and app settings as a readable JSON file (credentials such as API keys, proxy passwords and push URLs are excluded)
data_control.import_settings_description: Restore settings from an exported JSON file. Importing overwrites current settings and cannot be undone
data_control.import_settings_confirm_body: This overwrites your current settings with {{count}} items from the file (credentials are not affected) and cannot be undone.
data_control.import_settings_invalid_file: This is not a settings file exported by this app
data_control.mcp_outbound_hint: Once enabled, a local agent (Claude Code / Codex / Hermes, …) can read your reader directly: list feeds, pull unread entries, search keywords, fetch a single article.
data_control.mcp_enable_hint: When off, /mcp stops responding; the Token stays valid.
data_control.mcp_allow_write_hint: Off by default. When on, an agent may change state via mark_read / star_entry.
data_control.mcp_token_not_set: No Token yet — generate one before an agent can connect.
data_control.mcp_token_legacy_hint: This is a hash stored by the old version and cannot be shown — hit “Regenerate” once.
data_control.mcp_token_revoke_confirm_body: Every configured agent loses access immediately and needs the new Token.
data_control.mcp_base_url_hint: The address your agent uses to reach this Krss box (e.g. http://192.0.2.1:8082). The client config example above builds the /mcp URL from it; leave empty to use the current browser address (same thing on single-box deployments).
data_control.mcp_client_config_hint: Ready to paste: the Token is already filled in.
data_control.mcp_load_failed: Failed to load the MCP outbound status

auth.register_description: Create an account to start using Krss
auth.username_hint: Only lowercase letters and numbers allowed
auth.nickname_hint: Optional, defaults to username if empty
auth.password_too_short: Password must be at least 6 characters
auth.network_error: Unable to connect to server. Please check your network connection.
auth.network_error_description: Please check your network connection or server status and try again
auth.network_error_hint: If accessing via reverse proxy, please verify your proxy configuration and that the target port is reachable

profile.title: Profile
profile.username_readonly: Username cannot be changed after registration
profile.avatar_hint: Leave empty to use the Gravatar for your email; local images are resized to 128px
profile.avatar_invalid: That file is not an image

feeds.folder_overrides_hint: Applies to all {{count}} feeds, overwriting their individual overrides. Follow global clears them.
feeds.refresh_in_progress: Refresh in progress, please try again later
feeds.name: Name
feeds.summary_prompt_reminder_too_long: The custom prompt cannot exceed {{max}} characters

update.description: Click to refresh and apply the update

shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
shortcuts.description: Work on the list or the open article; ignored while typing

appearance_reading.title: Reading & list
appearance_reading.unread_badge_hint: Every option maps to an official HeroUI Badge prop
appearance_reading.unread_badge_color_hint: Turn the switch off to pick a color
appearance_reading.unread_badge_offset_hint: How far it bites into the icon
appearance_reading.unread_badge_preview_note: Updates live; applies to every list once saved
appearance_reading.unread_badge_dot_fixed: The dot is the default and has a fixed look (8px, theme accent, 2px overlap); the options below only apply to Count / Icon.

appearance_view.title: Per-view settings
appearance_view.description: Article / image / notification / social are four separate views
appearance_view.read_timing_disabled: Mark-as-read on scroll is off, so this has no effect
appearance_view.show_splitter_hint: Turn off to stop drawing the line (the hover drag indicator is unaffected); column widths are kept
appearance_view.timeline_granularity_hint: Entries in the same bucket share one node (grouping and node labels only; no refetch)
appearance_view.timeline_collapse_hint: Cards start collapsed; “Show full text” expands in place (the timeline does not jump)
appearance_view.timeline_single_side_hint: Automatically merge the two sides into one when narrow

automation.title: Automation
automation.subtitle: Rules run after entries are stored and only affect newly fetched entries by default (use “Apply to history” to backfill); first match wins, order is priority.
automation.muted_entries_hint: Everything your rules muted is kept here; lists hide them by default.
automation.empty_hint: Create one to start. Not sure a regex is safe? Run “Preview impact” first.
automation.order_hint: Matched top-down; the first hit stops the chain
automation.delete_description: The rule itself is removed. Tick the box to also restore the entries it muted.
automation.delete_with_revert: Also restore entries muted by it
automation.name: Name
automation.enabled_hint: Disabled rules are skipped, entries are untouched
automation.actions_hint: Mute = stored but hidden by default, reviewable and reversible. Opposite actions are mutually exclusive.
automation.keep_only_hint: “Keep only matches” mutes the entries that do NOT match.
automation.invalid: Name, scope and at least one action are required; values are required per operator
automation.apply_history_title: Run the rules over historical entries?
automation.apply_history_description: Scans the latest {{limit}} entries in this rule's scope and runs the rule chain over them (first match wins). Entries already handled by this rule are skipped, so running it twice is safe.
automation.views_hint: Filters entries without writing anything; saved views show up in the sidebar as everyday shortcuts
automation.view_actions_hint: A view performs no actions: it is reading-only and never touches read/mute/star state.
automation.view_needs_condition: A view needs at least one condition, otherwise it is just "all".
automation.view_active_hint: Using a saved view · leaves when you switch feed or content type
automation.delete_view_description: Removes only this shortcut; entries and rules are untouched.
automation.translate_hint: Marks the entry only: translation runs when you open it (no AI tokens at ingest time).
automation.summarize_hint: Marks the entry only: summarization runs when you open it.
automation.webhook_hint: POSTs the matched entry (JSON) to this URL; delivery failures are shown in red on the rule row.
automation.webhook_needs_url: A webhook action needs an http(s) URL.
automation.nl_title: Create a rule from a sentence
automation.nl_hint: Plain language → an AI draft → it only fills the editor, nothing is saved until you confirm (shared with the AI settings under Settings → AI).
automation.nl_placeholder: e.g. Mute posts whose title contains "sponsored" or "promo", but leave GitHub ones alone
automation.nl_ai_not_configured: AI is not configured yet: set provider / API key / model in Settings → AI.
automation.nl_draft_invalid: The model's answer was unusable (no condition or action) — try rephrasing.
automation.exception_created: Exception rule "{{name}}" created; this entry is back in unread
automation.exception_failed: Could not create the exception rule
automation.mute_blocked_by_keep_only: "Keep only matches" already mutes everything else — "Mute" can't be combined with it
automation.notify_url_placeholder: Leave empty to use the global push URL in Settings → General
automation.notify_hint: Push a notification (Bark-compatible) when matched: title + source + deep link. Leave the URL empty to follow the global push URL; delivery failures show as red text on the rule row.
automation.unsaved_description: This rule has unsaved changes. Save before leaving, or discard them?
automation.scope_feed_multi_hint: Multi-select: the scope covers every selected feed
automation.view_only_in_hint: Nothing selected = show in every view (default).
automation.revert_impact_description: These entries are still owned by this rule. Only the ones you check will be reverted.
automation.revert_impact_empty: This rule currently affects no entries
automation.revert_include_starred: Also unstar entries this rule starred ({{count}})

appearance_shape.title: Shape
appearance_shape.description: Corner radius for components, form fields and feed icons (values from HeroUI's scale, base 8px)
appearance_shape.preview_hint: Change the knobs above and this updates live (not clickable)

proxy.section_description: Feeds and folders can each override the global proxy. Resolution order: feed → folder (parent chain) → global; the closest one wins.
proxy.global_disabled_warning: Global proxy is off: only sources with their own proxy config will use one
proxy.missing_config: no usable address, falls back to direct
proxy.dialog_subtitle: Feed → folder chain → global — the nearest layer wins
